clue.text: One making religious ceremony sound different

indicators.note: sound tells us to take a word as heard, so a spoken word gives a differently spelt one

parts.note: a rite is a religious ceremony

explanation.surface: Someone is changing the way a church service sounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'different' tells us the spelling changes though the sound is the same: RITE is said like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A wright is a maker or builder, as in shipwright or playwright.

clue.text: Winger from Real Madrid

indicators.note: from here means the letters are made out of the team name, rearranged

explanation.surface: A wide player comes from the Spanish football club Real Madrid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' signals that the answer is made from the letters of REAL MADRID.
explanation.definitionFit: A red admiral is a butterfly, and a winged creature can be called a winger in crosswords.

clue.text: Look — transparent fabric has middle missing

indicators.note: the central letter of the fabric's five-letter name is dropped

parts.note: gauze is a thin see-through fabric

explanation.surface: Inspect a see-through cloth that has a hole in the centre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has middle missing' removes U, the central letter of GAUZE.
explanation.definitionFit: To gaze is to look steadily, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Imagine a profit will change one's opinion

parts.note: to imagine is to think
a profit is a gain

explanation.surface: Picturing a financial windfall makes someone reconsider.
explanation.definitionFit: To think again is an idiom for reconsidering and changing your view.

clue.text: Sound expert left on the internet

parts.note: crack means expert, as in a crack shot
E as in e-mail stands for electronic or online

explanation.surface: A specialist on the left speaks out online.
explanation.definitionFit: A crackle is a noise of small sharp snaps, a kind of sound.

clue.text: Extremely heavy drill received shrewd publicity

indicators.note: extremely asks for the extreme letters, first and last, of the next word

parts.note: PE, physical education, is school exercise or drill

explanation.surface: A heavy training session got clever promotion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'received' links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Hype is exaggerated promotion, crafted publicity designed to stir up excitement.

clue.text: Victoria's comedown in Australia

parts.note: Victoria was a queen, so the possessive gives a queen's
to come down after flight is to land

explanation.surface: Queen Victoria descends somewhere in Australia.
explanation.walkthrough: Victoria is also a neighbouring Australian state, a misleading lure.
explanation.definitionFit: Queensland is the north-eastern state of Australia, named after Queen Victoria.

clue.text: Moderate Christian I leave

indicators.note: leave means this letter departs from the word before it

parts.note: a gentile is a non-Jew, often meaning a Christian

explanation.surface: A mild believer says he is departing.
explanation.definitionFit: Gentle means mild or moderate in degree or manner.

clue.text: Just what is needed now second person has arrived

definitions.meaning: said when handing over exactly the thing wanted
addressed to a second person on arrival, you are now in this place

explanation.surface: Just the thing: now the second guest has turned up.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is spoken when handing someone something, and also greets someone arriving at a destination.

clue.text: Distracted a celebrant in place of worship

indicators.note: distracted means thrown into disorder, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A priest is not concentrating during a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: A tabernacle is a building or tent used for worship.

clue.text: Once it could offer an opening

parts.note: ex means former, once

explanation.surface: Once upon a time it might have provided a chance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could offer an' links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An exit is a way out of a room or building, an opening to leave by.

clue.text: Firepower running short

parts.note: a munitions word cut down to its short informal form, or supplies of bullets running low

explanation.surface: An army is running low on munitions.
explanation.definitionFit: Ammo is the informal clipped form of ammunition, the firepower of guns.

clue.text: Pretty useless

definitions.meaning: for show only, without practical function

explanation.definitionFit: Ornamental things are decorative and serve as embellishment rather than any practical function.

clue.text: Still like peas in a pod

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means nevertheless, and also literally identical to each other.

clue.text: Term of endearment by one consuming bird

parts.note: honey is an affectionate form of address
an eater is someone who consumes food

explanation.surface: A sweetheart sits next to someone eating a bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' means beside, so the two pieces sit together.
explanation.definitionFit: Honeyeaters are an Australasian family of nectar-feeding birds.

clue.text: Mum's home country?

parts.note: read playfully as the territory belonging to one's mother

explanation.definitionFit: A motherland is one's native country, the nation of birth.

clue.text: An attack to be faced?

parts.note: an assault met head-on, coming at you from the front

explanation.definitionFit: A frontal attack is a direct assault on the enemy's front line.

clue.text: Princess, aficionado in anti-movement

indicators.note: in places one piece within the other
movement means the letters of the word are moved about

parts.note: an aficionado is a fan

explanation.surface: A princess who is a devotee joins a protest movement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'anti-movement' reads as a protest group, but 'movement' rearranges the letters to INTA; 'in' then places the fan within.
explanation.definitionFit: An infanta is a daughter of a Spanish or Portuguese king, a princess.

clue.text: Man causing friction at work

parts.note: not a troublesome colleague but someone whose job is literally rubbing

explanation.definitionFit: A masseur is a man who gives massages, rubbing clients' muscles for a living.

clue.text: Simple principle Ray manipulated

parts.note: an element is a basic principle

explanation.surface: Ray twisted a basic principle.
explanation.definitionFit: Elementary means basic or simple, as in elementary school.

clue.text: Very unusual verse Oscar completed

indicators.note: unusual signals the letters in an odd order

parts.note: Oscar is O in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: An odd poem written by Oscar is finished.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an informal intensifier meaning extremely.

clue.text: Isn't there much to chew over at this conference?

definitions.text: Isn't there much to chew over at this conference?

parts.words: Isn't there much to chew over at this conference?
parts.note: a formal assembly that sounds like a meagre eating regime

explanation.definitionFit: A diet is a legislative assembly, as in the Diet of Worms, and also a restricted eating plan.

clue.text: Started enveloping some flower

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Something began to wrap up a bloom.
explanation.walkthrough: In crosswords a 'flower' is often something that flows, a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Eden is a river in Cumbria, England, and a river flows.

clue.text: Merely a toff, that's a good thing

parts.note: just means merely
a swell is a fashionable upper-class person, a toff

explanation.surface: Merely being a posh gentleman is fortunate.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means luckily or fortunately, given the circumstances.

clue.text: Juliet Newton went round Ohio to find a man

indicators.note: went round means surrounded the next piece

parts.note: J in the NATO phonetic alphabet
N is the symbol for newton, a unit of force
OH is the postal abbreviation for Ohio

explanation.surface: A girl and a scientist travel around a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: John is a common male name, so a man.

clue.text: Crawler with no backbone

parts.note: an invertebrate creature, or a spineless grovelling person

explanation.definitionFit: A worm is a crawling invertebrate and also a contemptible weak person.

clue.text: Restaurant, second take out before reaching home

indicators.note: before reaching says these pieces come ahead of the last one
out signals the letters are put out of order

parts.note: a house is a home

explanation.surface: Grab a takeaway meal quickly before getting home.
explanation.definitionFit: A steakhouse is a restaurant specialising in steaks.

clue.text: Army craftsmen have 24 hours without a cure

parts.note: REME is the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers, the British army's technical corps

indicators.note: without means the letter is left out of the day

parts.note: 24 hours is a day

explanation.surface: Army engineers go a whole day without a fix.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' drops A from DAY to give DY.
explanation.definitionFit: A remedy is a cure or treatment.
